description: Replace the sky in the active document (Edit > Sky Replacement) with an image file, without the dialog. Photoshop finds the sky, adds a Sky Replacement group with the new sky and lighting and colour layers, and returns it. Edge, brightness, temperature, lighting and colour settings match the dialog's

lightingMode.description: Lighting mode for the foreground lighting layer. Default screen; Photoshop may choose its own blend from the sky

output.description: Output to new layers (default) or a duplicate layer

skyFile.description: Absolute path to the sky image (a Sky_Presets image or any JPEG or PNG)

name: replace_sky
title: Replace Sky
